meta.title: GoViet — Vietnamese input for macOS
meta.description: A Vietnamese input method for macOS in the Unikey tradition: Telex and VNI, in every app, with a shortcut to switch English and Vietnamese. Open source.

hero.sub: Telex and VNI, in every app. No input-source switching.
hero.a11y: Demo: the Telex sequence Tooi ddang gox tieengs Vieetj becomes Tôi đang gõ tiếng Việt, then Control-Shift switches to English.

telex.p: The same word, in the two methods you already know from Windows.

english.p: English words are restored when you finish typing, instead of becoming broken Vietnamese.
english.a11y: English restore demo: words such as text, add, and request stay English instead of becoming broken Vietnamese.

apps.h: Safari in Vietnamese. Terminal in English.
apps.p: GoViet remembers the language per app. Games can be excluded entirely.

native.p: Native settings, ⌃⇧ shortcut, launch at login. Not a system input source.

more.everywhereP: Safari, Chrome, VS Code, Terminal, Messages, Notes, Slack. The engine intercepts keyboard events system-wide.
more.macroP: Unlimited length, JSON import/export, case follows how you typed. No built-in pairs.
more.secureP: When macOS enables secure input (password fields), GoViet pauses and shows a lock in the menu bar.

engine.h: Rust handles the letters. Swift talks to macOS.
engine.p: A pure logic engine with unit tests. The macOS shell owns the event tap, key injection, and per-app memory.

install.p: Current builds are signed with an Apple Development certificate, not notarized. macOS will ask for an extra step.
install.s1d: Get the universal .dmg (Apple Silicon and Intel).
install.s3d: Open once so macOS records it. Then System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. Or run xattr -cr /Applications/GoViet.app.
install.s4d: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility → enable GoViet. No logout. VI/EN appears in the menu bar.

trust.p: GoViet needs Accessibility to read and rewrite keyboard events in other apps. That is how a Unikey-style engine works on macOS, rather than as a system input source.
trust.open: The source is on GitHub. You can read the engine and the macOS shell.
trust.local: Typing runs on your Mac. There is no GoViet account.
trust.noClaim: This is not a claim of zero risk. Grant the permission to software you trust.

limits.p: English words that are also valid Vietnamese syllables can pick up tone marks, same as Unikey: this becomes thí, mix becomes mĩ. Press ESC to restore the original keys, double-tap the tone key, or switch to EN. GoViet remembers the mode per app.

cta.p: Download GoViet, drag it into Applications, start typing.
